scenarios.scenario: Open a saved document from Home

scenario_steps.name: Home is active with no model document open in the MCAD Software
a saved document fixture is available
`fixtures/cad/single-occurrence.oad` and its referenced native component are available
the user opens the saved fixture through the Open dialog
the fixture document becomes active in a document tab
its document workspace is displayed
Home remains available

scenarios.scenario: Cancel Open while a model document is active

scenario_steps.name: a model document is active in the MCAD Software
`fixtures/cad/extrusion/extrusion-rect-8mm.opd` is the active document
the user opens the Open dialog
the user cancels the Open dialog
the dialog closes
the same model document remains active

scenarios.scenario: Inspect a part file before opening it

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartOne.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a folder contains a saved part with a preview and metadata
the folder contains `fixtures/cad/extrusion/extrusion-rect-8mm.opd` with a saved preview and metadata
the user presses Control+O and navigates to that folder
the user selects the saved part
the part row is selected and the file name field identifies it
the preview displays the part
the Options pane displays Model State and Design View controls
the user chooses Details
the preview remains visible
the details include the file type, modification date, size, author and part number
the user cancels the Open dialog
the previously active part document remains displayed
